questions.question_text: Which of the following is known as the Schrodinger equation?
questions.answer: Ĥψ = Eψ is the formal expression for the Schrodinger equation in quantum mechanics.

questions.question_text: Two electrons occupying the same orbital are distinguished by ________ quantum number.
questions.answer: Spin quantum number differentiates two electrons in the same orbital.

questions.question_text: Heisenberg uncertainty principle mathematically describe that the product of the position and momentum of the particle is _______
questions.answer: Heisenberg's principle states the uncertainty in position and momentum is at least h/4π.

questions.question_text: Which of the following molecule is NOT homonuclear?
questions.answer: NO is heteronuclear, containing both nitrogen and oxygen.

questions.question_text: The filling up of Molecular orbital takes place according to ________
questions.answer: Electron filling in molecular orbitals follows Hund's rule of maximum multiplicity.

questions.question_text: One of the following complex is having “zero” oxidation state for the central metal ion.
questions.answer: In [Ni(CO)4], nickel has an oxidation state of zero.

questions.question_text: The energy required to pair up the electrons is called _________
questions.answer: Pairing energy refers to the energy needed to pair two electrons.

questions.question_text: Minimum inter-planar spacing required for Bragg's diffraction is ______.
questions.answer: Bragg's law gives d_min = λ/2 for the first order diffraction.

questions.question_text: The Zeff for 4s electron in potassium atom (Z=19) is _______
questions.answer: The effective nuclear charge (Zeff) for 4s electron in K is 2.20.

questions.question_text: The co-ordination number and oxidation state for the cobalt atom in the complex [Co(NH3)5Cl]Cl2 is ______ and ______
questions.answer: Co is surrounded by 6 ligands (coordination number 6) and has oxidation state +3.

questions.question_text: Chiral molecules which are non-superimposable mirror images of each other are called ______
questions.answer: Enantiomers are non-superimposable mirror images of each other.

questions.question_text: The plane which divides the molecule into 2 equal parts so that each half is the mirror image of the other half is called ________
questions.answer: A plane of symmetry divides a molecule into two mirror image halves.

questions.question_text: If our eyes travel in counter clockwise, direction from the functional group of highest priority to lowest priority, then the configuration is ______ .
questions.answer: Counter clockwise direction from high to low priority is S configuration.

questions.question_text: Which of the following compound would exhibit geometrical isomerism?
questions.answer: 2–Butene exhibits geometrical (cis-trans) isomerism.

questions.question_text: Identify the hard acid from the following:
questions.answer: AlCl3 is a hard acid according to HSAB theory.
questions.chapter: Unit 1: Hard soft acids and bases

questions.question_text: In gauche conformations, the methyl groups are
questions.answer: In gauche, methyl groups are 60° apart in the Newman projection.

questions.question_text: [Co(NH3)5 NO2]Cl2 and [Co(NH3)5 ONO]Cl2
questions.answer: Different connectivity of the NO2/ONO ligand forms linkage isomers.
questions.chapter: Unit 1: Isomerism in transitional metal compounds

questions.question_text: Find the number of stereo isomers for CH3-CH(OH)-CH=CH-CH3
questions.answer: Both the double bond (geometrical) and OH group (chiral center) give 2×2=4 stereoisomers.
questions.chapter: Unit 3: Stereochemistry - Structural isomers and stereoisomers

questions.question_text: Which of the following act as an initiator in free radical mechanism?
questions.answer: Benzoyl peroxide generates free radicals and acts as an initiator in polymerization.

questions.question_text: An acceptor of pair of electrons is called ________
questions.answer: Electrophiles accept pairs of electrons during chemical reactions.
